name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefit_summary: Subsidies up to 40% (General) to 60% (Women, SC, ST) for modern fishing craft, safety gear, biofloc, cold storage, and aquaculture.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) guidelines.
required_documents: Fisherman Registration ID / Coastal Biometric Card
Pond Lease or Ownership Document (if aquaculture)
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
